The creature then returns to life, regaining a number of hit points equal to 4d10 + your Wisdom modifier. If the creature died while subject to any of the following conditions, it revives with them removed: blinded, deafened, paralyzed, poisoned, and stunned.

subclasses.name: Way of the Astral Self
subclasses.description: Manifest your ki as spectral astral arms

3.name: Arms of the Astral Self
3.description: Your mastery of your ki allows you to summon a portion of your astral self. As a bonus action, you can spend 1 ki point to summon the arms of your astral self. When you do so, each creature of your choice that you can see within 10 feet of you must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take force damage equal to two rolls of your Martial Arts die. For 10 minutes, these spectral arms hover near your shoulders or surround your arms. You can use the arms to make unarmed strikes with a reach of 10 feet, using your Wisdom modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity.

6.name: Visage of the Astral Self
6.description: You can summon the visage of your astral self. As a bonus action, or as part of the bonus action you take to activate Arms of the Astral Self, you can spend 1 ki point to summon this visage for 10 minutes. It covers your face like a helmet or mask. You gain the following benefits: Astral Sight (you can see normally in darkness to 120 feet), Wisdom of the Spirit (you have advantage on Insight and Intimidation checks), Word of the Spirit (when you speak, you can direct your words to a creature of your choice within 60 feet, making it so only that creature can hear you, or you can amplify your voice so that all creatures within 600 feet can hear you).

11.name: Body of the Astral Self
11.description: When you have both your astral arms and visage summoned, you can cause the body of your astral self to appear (no action required). This spectral body covers your physical form like a suit of armor, connecting with the arms and visage. You are now under the effects of both, and you also gain the following benefits: Deflect Energy (when you take acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, or thunder damage, you can use your reaction to deflect it, reducing the damage by 1d10 + your Wisdom modifier), Empowered Arms (once on each of your turns when you hit with your astral arms, you can deal extra damage to the target equal to your Martial Arts die).

17.name: Awakened Astral Self
17.description: Your connection to your astral self is complete, allowing you to unleash its full potential. As a bonus action, you can spend 5 ki points to summon the arms, visage, and body of your astral self and awaken it for 10 minutes. This awakening ends early if you are incapacitated or die. While your astral self is awakened, you gain the following benefits: Armor of the Spirit (you gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class), Astral Barrage (whenever you use the Extra Attack feature to attack twice, you can instead attack three times if all the attacks are made with your astral arms).

subclasses.name: Way of the Ascendant Dragon
subclasses.description: Emulate the power of dragons

3.name: Draconic Disciple
3.description: You can touch your ki and channel it to manifest the power of a dragon. You learn to speak, read, and write Draconic or one other language of your choice. You can change the damage type of your unarmed strikes to acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison.

3.name: Breath of the Dragon
3.description: You can channel destructive waves of energy, like those created by the dragons you emulate. When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of the attacks with an exhalation of draconic energy in either a 20-foot cone or a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide (your choice). Choose a damage type: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking damage equal to two rolls of your Martial Arts die on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus.

6.name: Wings Unfurled
6.description: When you use your Step of the Wind, you can unfurl spectral draconic wings from your back that vanish at the end of your turn. While the wings exist, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus.

11.name: Aspect of the Wyrm
11.description: The power of your draconic spirit now radiates from you, warding your allies or inspiring terror in your enemies. As a bonus action, you can create an aura of draconic power that radiates 10 feet from you for 1 minute. For the duration, you gain one of the following effects of your choice: Frightful Presence (when you create this aura, and as a bonus action on subsequent turns, you can choose a creature within the aura. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of you for 1 minute), Resistance (choose a damage type when you activate this aura: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. You and your allies within the aura have resistance to that damage).

17.name: Ascendant Aspect
17.description: Your draconic spirit reaches its peak. You gain the following benefits: Augment Breath (when you use your Breath of the Dragon, you can spend 1 ki point to augment its shape and power. The exhalation of draconic energy becomes either a 60-foot cone or a 90-foot line that is 5 feet wide (your choice), and each creature in that area takes damage equal to four rolls of your Martial Arts die on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one). Blindsight (you gain blindsight out to 10 feet. Within that range, you can effectively see anything that isn't behind total cover, even if you're blinded or in darkness). Explosive Fury (when you activate your Aspect of the Wyrm, draconic fury explodes from you. Choose any number of creatures you can see in your aura. Each of those creatures must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 3d10 acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison damage (your choice)).

subclasses.name: Warrior of the Mystic Arts
subclasses.description: A monk who blends martial prowess with arcane magic, wielding spells alongside their fists

3.name: Mystic Spellcasting
3.description: You augment your martial arts with the ability to cast spells. You learn two cantrips of your choice from the wizard spell list. You learn two 1st-level wizard spells of your choice from the abjuration, divination, or transmutation schools. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells. You can cast your known spells using ki points instead of spell slots, spending ki points equal to 1 + the spell's level.

3.name: Arcane Deflection
3.description: When you are hit by an attack or fail a saving throw, you can use your reaction to gain a +2 bonus to AC against that attack or a +4 bonus to that saving throw. When you use this feature, you can't cast spells other than cantrips until the end of your next turn.

6.name: Mystic Strike
6.description: You learn to infuse your unarmed strikes with magical energy. Once per turn when you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, you can expend 1 ki point to deal an extra 1d6 force damage. This damage increases to 2d6 at 11th level and 3d6 at 17th level.

6.name: Ki-Fueled Casting
6.description: When you cast a spell using ki points, you can make one unarmed strike as a bonus action.

11.name: Spell Reflection
11.description: When you use your Arcane Deflection feature and the triggering effect was a spell, you can spend 2 ki points to reflect the spell back at the caster. The caster must make a saving throw against your ki save DC, taking force damage equal to your Martial Arts die + your Wisdom modifier on a failed save.

17.name: Perfect Harmony
17.description: You have achieved perfect balance between martial and magical arts. When you use your action to cast a spell, you can make two unarmed strikes as a bonus action. Additionally, your Mystic Strike damage increases to 4d6.

subclasses.name: Warrior of Waves
subclasses.pcCreatableNote: Coming after the MVP — NPCs can still be this subclass.
subclasses.description: Monks who follow the Warrior of Waves emulate the fluid, ever-changing nature of water, using flowing movements that can crash with devastating force or flow around obstacles

3.name: Fluid Motion
3.description: Your movements become like water. You gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed, and you can breathe underwater. Additionally, when you use your Step of the Wind feature, you can move through hostile creatures' spaces without provoking opportunity attacks.

3.name: Crashing Wave
3.description: When you use your Flurry of Blows, you can push each creature you hit up to 10 feet away from you. If a creature is pushed into a solid surface or another creature, it takes bludgeoning damage equal to your Martial Arts die.

6.name: Water's Resilience
6.description: You can use your ki to absorb and redirect kinetic energy. When you take bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, you can use your reaction to spend 1 ki point and reduce the damage by an amount equal to your Martial Arts die + your Wisdom modifier.

6.name: Current's Pull
6.description: When a creature within 5 feet of you moves, you can use your reaction to move up to half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks, provided you end this movement within 5 feet of that creature.

11.name: Tidal Strike
11.description: Your attacks flow with the power of the tide. Once per turn when you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, you can force it to make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is knocked prone and pulled up to 15 feet toward you. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier.

17.name: Tsunami
17.description: As an action, you can spend 4 ki points to create a wave of force in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 10d6 bludgeoning damage, is pushed 30 feet away from you, and is knocked prone. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and isn't pushed or knocked prone.

paladin.name: Paladin
paladin.description: A holy warrior bound to a sacred oath — and the oath is the point. You smite evil with divine power, shield your allies with your very presence, and hold the line no matter what it costs.
features: Divine Sense - Detect the presence of undead, celestials, and fiends within 60 feet

Lay on Hands - Your pool of healing power equals 5 × your paladin level. As a bonus action, you can touch a creature to restore hit points from the pool, and you can expend 5 hit points from the pool to remove the Poisoned condition
Spellcasting - You can cast paladin spells using Charisma as your spellcasting ability

subclasses.name: Oath of Devotion
subclasses.description: Paragon of justice and righteousness

3.name: Channel Divinity: Sacred Weapon
3.description: When you take the Attack action, you can imbue one weapon you are carrying with positive energy for 10 minutes. You add your Charisma modifier to attack rolls made with that weapon (minimum +1), and when you hit with it you can choose for the damage to be its normal type or Radiant. The weapon sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The effect ends early if you use this feature again, end it (no action required), or are no longer carrying the weapon.

7.name: Aura of Devotion
7.description: You and your allies have Immunity to the Charmed condition while in your Aura of Protection. A Charmed ally entering your Aura of Protection has the condition suppressed while there.

15.name: Smite of Protection
15.description: Whenever you cast Divine Smite, you and your allies have Half Cover while in your Aura of Protection. The aura has this benefit until the start of your next turn.

20.name: Holy Nimbus
20.description: As a bonus action, you imbue your Aura of Protection for 10 minutes or until you end it (no action required). Holy Ward — you have Advantage on saving throws you are forced to make by a Fiend or an Undead. Radiant Damage — whenever an enemy starts its turn in the aura, it takes Radiant damage equal to your Charisma modifier + your Proficiency Bonus. Sunlight — the aura is filled with Bright Light that is sunlight. Once per Long Rest, or restore the use by expending a level 5 spell slot (no action required).

subclasses.name: Oath of the Ancients
subclasses.description: Protector of light and life against darkness

3.name: Channel Divinity: Nature's Wrath
3.description: As a Magic action, spectral vines lash out at each creature of your choice that you can see within 15 feet of you. Each target must make a Strength saving throw or have the Restrained condition for 1 minute. A Restrained creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

7.name: Aura of Warding
7.description: You and your allies have Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant damage while in your Aura of Protection.

15.name: Undying Sentinel
15.description: Once per Long Rest, when you are reduced to 0 Hit Points and not killed outright, you instead drop to 1 Hit Point and regain Hit Points equal to 3 × your Paladin level. You cease visibly aging and can't be aged magically.

20.name: Elder Champion
20.description: As a bonus action, you assume the form of an avatar of primeval nature for 1 minute or until you end the benefits (no action required). Diminish Defiance — enemies in your Aura of Protection have disadvantage on saving throws against your spells and Channel Divinity options. Regeneration — you regain 10 Hit Points at the start of each of your turns. Swift Spells — when you cast a spell with a casting time of 1 action, you can cast it as a Bonus Action instead. Once per Long Rest, or restore the use by expending a level 5 spell slot (no action required).

subclasses.name: Oath of Vengeance
subclasses.description: Avenger who punishes wrongdoers

3.name: Channel Divinity: Vow of Enmity
3.description: When you take the Attack action, you can swear an oath of enmity against a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. You gain Advantage on attack rolls against that creature for 1 minute or until you use this feature again. If the creature drops to 0 Hit Points before the vow ends, you can transfer the vow to a different creature you can see within 30 feet of you (no action required).

7.name: Relentless Avenger
7.description: When you hit a creature with an Opportunity Attack, you can reduce the creature's Speed to 0 until the end of the current turn. You can then move up to half your Speed as part of the same Reaction, and this movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

15.name: Soul of Vengeance
15.description: Immediately after a creature under the effect of your Vow of Enmity hits or misses with an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to make a melee attack against that creature if it's within range.

20.name: Avenging Angel
20.description: As a bonus action, you assume the form of an angelic avenger for 10 minutes or until you end it (no action required). Flight — spectral wings grant you a Fly Speed of 60 feet, and you can hover. Frightful Aura — whenever an enemy starts its turn in your Aura of Protection, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition for 1 minute or until it takes any damage; attack rolls against the Frightened creature have Advantage. Once per Long Rest, or restore the use by expending a level 5 spell slot (no action required).

subclasses.name: Oath of Conquest
subclasses.description: Tyrannical warrior who crushes enemies

3.name: Channel Divinity: Conquering Presence
3.description: You can use your Channel Divinity to exude a terrifying presence. As an action, you force each creature of your choice within 30 feet to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature becomes frightened of you for 1 minute.

3.name: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike
3.description: When you make an attack roll, you can use your Channel Divinity to gain a +10 bonus to the roll.

7.name: Aura of Conquest
7.description: Creatures that are frightened of you have their speed reduced to 0 while within 10 feet of you, and they take psychic damage equal to half your paladin level if they start their turn there. At 18th level, the range increases to 30 feet.

15.name: Scornful Rebuke
15.description: Whenever a creature hits you with an attack, that creature takes psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1) if you're not incapacitated.

20.name: Invincible Conqueror
20.description: You gain the ability to harness extraordinary martial prowess. As an action, you gain the following benefits for 1 minute: you have resistance to all damage, when you take the Attack action, you can make one additional attack, and your melee weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

subclasses.name: Oath of Redemption
subclasses.description: Pacifist who seeks to redeem the wicked

3.name: Channel Divinity: Emissary of Peace
3.description: As a bonus action, you grant yourself a +5 bonus to Charisma (Persuasion) checks for the next 10 minutes.

3.name: Channel Divinity: Rebuke the Violent
3.description: Immediately after an attacker within 30 feet deals damage with an attack against a creature other than you, you can use your reaction to force the attacker to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the attacker takes radiant damage equal to the damage it just dealt. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.

7.name: Aura of the Guardian
7.description: When a creature within 10 feet of you takes damage, you can use your reaction to magically take that damage instead. This feature doesn't transfer any other effects that might accompany the damage. At 18th level, the range increases to 30 feet.

15.name: Protective Spirit
15.description: A holy presence mends your wounds in battle. You regain hit points equal to 1d6 + half your paladin level if you end your turn in combat with fewer than half of your hit points remaining and you aren't incapacitated.

20.name: Emissary of Redemption
20.description: You become an avatar of peace. You have resistance to all damage dealt by other creatures. Whenever a creature hits you with an attack, it takes radiant damage equal to half the damage you take from the attack. If you attack a creature, cast a spell on it, or deal damage to it, these benefits are suspended for that creature.

subclasses.name: Oath of Glory
subclasses.description: Champion who seeks to achieve legendary deeds

3.name: Channel Divinity: Peerless Athlete
3.description: As a bonus action, you augment your athleticism for 1 hour. You have Advantage on Strength (Athletics) and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks, and your Long Jump and High Jump distances increase by 10 feet (the extra distance costs movement as normal).

3.name: Channel Divinity: Inspiring Smite
3.description: Immediately after you cast Divine Smite, you can distribute Temporary Hit Points equal to 2d8 + your Paladin level among creatures of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of you; the total can include you.

7.name: Aura of Alacrity
7.description: Your Speed increases by 10 feet. Whenever an ally enters your Aura of Protection for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there, their Speed increases by 10 feet until the end of their next turn.

15.name: Glorious Defense
15.description: When you or another creature you can see within 10 feet of you is hit by an attack roll, you can use your reaction to grant a bonus to the target's AC equal to your Charisma modifier, potentially causing the attack to miss. If the attack misses, you can make one weapon attack against the attacker as part of this reaction, provided the attacker is within your weapon's range. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

20.name: Living Legend
20.description: As a bonus action, you empower yourself with the legends of your great deeds for 10 minutes. You gain Advantage on all Charisma checks. Unerring Strike — once per turn, you can turn a missed attack roll into a hit. Saving Throw Reroll — when you fail a saving throw, you can take a Reaction to reroll it, and you must use the new roll. Once per Long Rest, or restore the use by expending a level 5 spell slot (no action required).

subclasses.name: Oath of the Watchers
subclasses.description: Sentinel against extraplanar threats

3.name: Channel Divinity: Watcher's Will
3.description: You can use your Channel Divinity to invest your presence with the warding power of your faith. As an action, you choose a number of creatures you can see within 30 feet of you, up to a number equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one creature). For 1 minute, you and the chosen creatures have advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

3.name: Channel Divinity: Abjure the Extraplanar
3.description: You can use your Channel Divinity to castigate unworldly beings. As an action, you present your holy symbol and each aberration, celestial, elemental, fey, or fiend within 30 feet of you that can hear you must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is turned for 1 minute or until it takes damage.

7.name: Aura of the Sentinel
7.description: You emit an aura of alertness while you aren't incapacitated. When you and any creatures of your choice within 10 feet of you roll initiative, you each gain a bonus to initiative equal to your proficiency bonus. At 18th level, the range increases to 30 feet.

15.name: Vigilant Rebuke
15.description: You've learned how to chastise anyone who dares wield beguilements against you and your wards. Whenever you or a creature you can see within 30 feet of you succeeds on an Intelligence, a Wisdom, or a Charisma saving throw, you can use your reaction to deal 2d8 + your Charisma modifier force damage to the creature that forced the saving throw.

20.name: Mortal Bulwark
20.description: You manifest a spark of divine power in defense of the mortal realms. As a bonus action, you gain the following benefits for 1 minute: you gain truesight with a range of 120 feet; you have advantage on attack rolls against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, and fiends; when you hit a creature with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also force it to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is magically banished to its native plane of existence if it's not currently there.

subclasses.name: Oathbreaker
subclasses.description: Fallen paladin who serves dark powers

3.name: Channel Divinity: Control Undead
3.description: As an action, you target one undead creature you can see within 30 feet. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target must obey your commands for the next 24 hours, or until you use this Channel Divinity option again.

3.name: Channel Divinity: Dreadful Aspect
3.description: As an action, you channel the darkest emotions and focus them into a burst of magical menace. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw if it can see you. On a failed save, the target is frightened of you for 1 minute.

7.name: Aura of Hate
7.description: You, as well as any fiends and undead within 10 feet of you, gain a bonus to melee weapon damage rolls equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of +1). At 18th level, the range increases to 30 feet.

15.name: Supernatural Resistance
15.description: You gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons.

20.name: Dread Lord
20.description: You can, as an action, surround yourself with an aura of gloom that lasts for 1 minute. The aura reduces any bright light in a 30-foot radius around you to dim light. Whenever an enemy that is frightened by you starts its turn in the aura, it takes 4d10 psychic damage. Additionally, you and any creatures of your choosing in the aura are draped in deeper shadow. Creatures that rely on sight have disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures draped in this shadow.

subclasses.name: Oath of the Spellguard
subclasses.description: Paladins who swear the Oath of the Spellguard dedicate themselves to protecting the world from the misuse of magic and hunting down those who wield arcane power for evil

3.name: Channel Divinity: Spellbreaker
3.description: As an action, you can use your Channel Divinity to attempt to end a spell affecting a creature you can touch. Make an ability check using your Charisma modifier. The DC equals 10 + the spell's level. On a success, the spell ends.

3.name: Channel Divinity: Arcane Pursuit
3.description: When a creature you can see within 60 feet casts a spell, you can use your reaction and your Channel Divinity to move up to your speed toward that creature. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. If you end this movement within 5 feet of the creature, you can make one weapon attack against it as part of this reaction.

7.name: Aura of the Spellguard
7.description: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you have advantage on saving throws against spells. At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

15.name: Spell Resistance
15.description: You have resistance to damage from spells. Additionally, when you succeed on a saving throw against a spell, you take no damage if you would normally take half damage on a successful save.

20.name: Champion of the Spellguard
20.description: As an action, you can become an avatar of antimagic for 1 minute. During this time: you are immune to damage from spells and magical effects; you can cast Counterspell at will without expending a spell slot; when you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can end one spell of your choice affecting that creature. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

subclasses.name: Oath of Resolve
subclasses.description: Paladins who take the Oath of Resolve are unwavering in their dedication, standing firm against impossible odds and inspiring others through their unshakeable determination

3.name: Channel Divinity: Unyielding Stand
3.description: As a bonus action, you plant yourself firmly and invoke your divine resolve. For 1 minute, you can't be moved against your will, you have advantage on saving throws against being knocked prone or stunned, and you add your Charisma modifier to Constitution saving throws.

3.name: Channel Divinity: Inspire Courage
3.description: As an action, you can bolster the resolve of your allies. Choose a number of creatures you can see within 30 feet equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1). Each creature gains temporary hit points equal to your paladin level + your Charisma modifier and can't be frightened while these temporary hit points remain.

7.name: Aura of Determination
7.description: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you can't be charmed while you are conscious. Additionally, when an ally within your aura would be reduced to 0 hit points, they can choose to be reduced to 1 hit point instead. Once a creature benefits from this feature, it can't do so again until it finishes a long rest. At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

15.name: Unbreakable Will
15.description: You have advantage on all saving throws. Additionally, when you fail a saving throw, you can choose to succeed instead. Once you use this ability to succeed, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

20.name: Avatar of Resolve
20.description: As an action, you become an embodiment of unwavering determination for 1 minute. During this time: you are immune to the charmed, frightened, paralyzed, and stunned conditions; you have resistance to all damage; at the start of each of your turns, you regain hit points equal to your Charisma modifier if you have no more than half your hit points remaining. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

pugilist.description: A scrappy brawler who fights with fists, grit, and street smarts. You don't need a sword — you need a barstool, a dirty trick, and the stubbornness to get back up one more time than the other person.
features: Fisticuffs - Roll the Fisticuffs die (1d6, 1d8 at 5th, 1d10 at 11th, 1d12 at 17th) instead of normal damage for unarmed strikes and pugilist weapons; after an Attack action with one, make one unarmed strike or grapple as a bonus action
Iron Chin - Use Constitution instead of Dexterity for AC while wearing light or no armor and no shield
Moxie - Moxie points fuel special features; regain all moxie on a short or long rest

Street Smart - Carousing, shadowboxing, and sparring count as light activity for resting; after 8+ hours carousing in a settlement, know all its public locations and can't be lost there by nonmagical means
Bloodied But Unbowed - Reaction when damage drops you to half max HP or less: gain temp HP equal to pugilist level + Constitution modifier and regain all moxie; 1/short-or-long rest
Dig Deep - Bonus action: resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing for 1 minute; at the end of that minute, gain a level of exhaustion
Extra Attack - Attack twice with the Attack action
Haymaker - Before an unarmed/pugilist melee attack roll without disadvantage, declare haymakers: all attack rolls until end of turn have disadvantage, and damage dice use maximum results
Moxie-Fueled Fists - Unarmed strikes count as magical for overcoming resistance/immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage
Fancy Footwork - Gain proficiency in Dexterity saving throws
Shake It Off - Action to end one effect causing you to be charmed or frightened
Down But Not Out - When you use Bloodied But Unbowed, may also add proficiency bonus to damage with unarmed attacks/pugilist weapons for the next minute
School of Hard Knocks - Resistance to psychic damage; advantage on saves vs stunned or unconscious
Rabble Rouser - After a long rest carousing in a settlement, advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) and Charisma (Intimidation) rolls vs people who live there
Unbreakable - Advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saves; when you fail a save, spend 1 moxie to reroll and take the second result
Herculean - Carrying capacity doubled; damage to inanimate objects with melee weapons/unarmed strikes doubled; standing jump distance equals running-start jump distance
Fighting Spirit - With 4 or fewer exhaustion levels, when reduced to 0 HP: regain half max HP, half max moxie, gain a level of exhaustion; 1/long rest
Peak Physical Condition - Strength and Constitution increase by 2 (max 22); on a long rest recover 2 exhaustion levels and regain all expended hit dice
pugilist.name: Pugilist

subclasses.description: Gladiators and showfighters who turn combat into performance art

11.description: Base movement +10 feet, jump distance doubled, Dash as a bonus action.
11.name: High Flyer

17.description: Replace one unarmed/pugilist weapon attack: jump up to movement speed in any direction, attack with advantage; on a hit it is a critical and the target is stunned until the end of your next turn. On a hit: 1/long rest; on a miss: regained after 1 minute.
17.name: Signature Move

3.description: Bonus proficiency Performance (or Intimidation/Persuasion if already proficient). Adopt or discard an alternate persona as a bonus action; persona points (3 + Charisma modifier, min 1) spend in place of moxie and, before a Charisma check, add Strength modifier — only while adopted; regain on a long rest.
3.name: Persona Libre

6.description: Action while persona adopted: creatures within 30 feet who can see you save Wisdom (DC 8 + proficiency + Strength) or be charmed (adoration) or frightened (fear) for 1 minute, repeating on taking damage from you or allies; 1/long rest.
6.name: Work the Crowd

subclasses.name: Arena Royale

subclasses.description: Investigative brawlers who read a city the way others read a book

11.description: On a long rest in a settlement, it becomes your familiar settlement: cannot be surprised, add proficiency bonus to initiative, darkvision 120 feet, double proficiency bonus on Insight/Investigation/Perception checks that add proficiency, cannot be lost by any means, travel between two points twice as fast outside combat.
11.name: Heart of the City

17.description: Bonus action, 1 moxie: for 1 minute, advantage on saves vs blinded/deafened and truesight 30 feet.
17.name: Eyes Wide Open

3.description: Advantage on initiative; advantage on attacks vs creatures that have not acted yet in the first round. Detective Work: proficiency in two of Insight, Investigation, Perception; spend 1 moxie for advantage on an Intelligence (Investigation), Wisdom (Insight), or Wisdom (Perception) check.
3.name: Ever Vigilant

6.description: Bonus action, 2 moxie, visible enemy within 30 feet: for 1 minute you have advantage on weapon attacks vs it and add proficiency bonus to AC vs its attacks, or until reused.
6.name: Scrap Like a Sleuth

subclasses.name: Bloodhound Bruisers

subclasses.description: Brawlers who fight beside a loyal hound

11.description: Reaction: when a creature damages your hound with an attack, make an opportunity attack against it if in range.
11.name: Hound's Best Friend

17.description: The hound uses dire wolf statistics instead of wolf statistics, except its size remains Medium, with all Brawler's Best Friend modifications.
17.name: Dire Hound

3.description: Bonus proficiency Animal Handling (or Perception/Survival if already proficient). A hound using wolf statistics, adding your proficiency bonus to AC, saves, attack and damage rolls, +1d8 hit die per level after 3rd; bonus-action verbal commands; acts alone if you are incapacitated or absent. Mutt With Moxie shares Brace Up temp HP, lets the hound make Old One-Two attacks, and lets the hound Dash via Stick and Move.
3.name: Brawler's Best Friend

6.description: The hound's attacks count as magical. Coordinated Attack: when you take the Attack action, if the hound can see you it may use its reaction to make a melee attack.
6.name: Arcanine Bite

subclasses.name: Dog & Hound

subclasses.description: Foul-mouthed provocateurs who weaponize insult and dirty tricks

11.description: Reaction + 1 moxie for advantage on a Charisma (Intimidation) check, or reaction + 1 moxie to impose disadvantage on a creature's save vs your Piss & Vinegar features.
11.name: Mean Old Cuss

17.description: Salty Salute may target up to your pugilist level in creatures within 60 feet; gain 1 moxie (up to max) the first time each targeted creature hits you before the start of your next turn; 1/long rest.
17.name: The Uncouth Art

3.description: Bonus proficiency Intimidation (if not already possessed). Bonus action: provoke a creature within 60 feet who can see/hear you — Wisdom save (DC 8 + proficiency + Charisma) or take Fisticuffs die + Charisma modifier psychic damage and disadvantage on attacks not including you until the start of your next turn.
3.name: Salty Salute

6.description: Each once, regained on a short/long rest: Heelstomper (unarmed damage, Dexterity save or gain 1 moxie and halve target speed 1 minute), Low Blow (unarmed damage, Strength save or gain 1 moxie and knock prone), Pocket Sand (bonus action vs a creature within 5 feet, Constitution save or gain 1 moxie and blind until the end of its next turn).
6.name: Dirty Tricks

subclasses.name: Piss & Vinegar

subclasses.description: Grapplers who turn the ring into a weapon

11.description: Count as one size larger for grappling; move at full speed dragging/carrying a grappled creature your size or smaller.
11.name: Heavyweight

17.description: Advantage on all attacks vs a grappled creature; unarmed/pugilist weapon attacks vs a grappled creature crit on 19–20.
17.name: Clean Finish

3.description: Three additional moxie features: Compression Lock (reaction + 1 moxie when a creature breaks your grapple, forcing a reroll), Quick Pin (reaction + 1 moxie when hostile movement provokes an opportunity attack, grapple instead), To the Mat (bonus action + 1 moxie, grapple attack vs a creature in range, prone on success).
3.name: Groundwork

6.description: While grappling an enemy, half cover vs attacks from creatures you are not grappling; reaction + 1 moxie when such an attack misses — the attacker rerolls against the grappled creature.
6.name: Meat Shield

subclasses.name: The Squared Circle

subclasses.description: Technical counter-punchers who end fights with a single perfect blow

11.description: When you reduce damage to 0 and hit with Cross Counter, regain 1 moxie (up to max).
11.name: Float Like a Butterfly, Sting Like a Bee

17.description: On hitting with an unarmed/pugilist weapon, spend 1+ moxie instead of dealing damage — roll 3d12 + 2d12 per moxie beyond the first + pugilist level; if the total meets or beats the creature's remaining HP, it is unconscious for 10 minutes.
17.name: Knock Out

3.description: Reaction + 2 moxie: reduce damage from a melee weapon attack by 1d10 + Strength modifier + pugilist level; if reduced to 0, make an unarmed/pugilist weapon attack vs a creature in range as part of the same reaction.
3.name: Cross Counter

6.description: When your bonus-action Old One-Two hits the same creature with both attacks, spend 1 moxie for an additional unarmed strike in the same bonus action; on a hit the target is also knocked prone.
6.name: One, Two, Three, Floor

subclasses.name: The Sweet Science

toolProficiencies: One artisan's tool, gaming set, or thieves' tools of your choice

ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.description: A warrior of the wild edges, where civilization ends and the monsters begin. You track, hunt, and endure where others get lost, and your bow — and your nature magic — speak for the frontier.
features: Spellcasting - You can cast ranger spells using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability
Favored Enemy - You always have Hunter's Mark prepared, and you can cast it without expending a spell slot a number of times per long rest based on your level
Weapon Mastery - You can use the mastery properties of weapons you are proficient with

subclasses.name: Hunter
subclasses.description: Master of hunting and tracking prey

3.name: Hunter's Lore
3.description: While a creature is marked by your Hunter's Mark, you know whether that creature has any Immunities, Resistances, or Vulnerabilities, and if it has any, you know what they are.

3.name: Hunter's Prey
3.description: Choose one of the following features: Colossus Slayer (when you hit a creature with a weapon, the weapon deals an extra 1d8 damage if the target is missing any Hit Points, once per turn), or Horde Breaker (once on each of your turns when you make an attack with a weapon, you can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature within 5 feet of the original target, within the weapon's range, that you have not attacked this turn). You can replace the chosen option whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest.

7.name: Defensive Tactics
7.description: Choose one: Escape the Horde (Opportunity Attacks have Disadvantage against you), or Multiattack Defense (when a creature hits you with an attack roll, that creature has Disadvantage on all other attack rolls against you this turn). You can replace the chosen option whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest.

11.name: Superior Hunter's Prey
11.description: Once per turn when you deal damage to a creature marked by your Hunter's Mark, you can also deal that spell's extra damage to a different creature that you can see within 30 feet of the first creature.

15.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
15.description: When you take damage, you can use your Reaction to give yourself Resistance to that damage and any other damage of the same type until the end of the current turn.

subclasses.name: Beast Master
subclasses.description: Ranger bonded with an animal companion

3.name: Primal Companion
3.description: You magically summon a primal beast; choose its stat block — Beast of the Land, Beast of the Sea, or Beast of the Sky. All three have AC 13 plus your Wisdom modifier and add your Proficiency Bonus to their ability checks and saving throws. Land: Hit Points 5 plus five times your Ranger level (d8 Hit Dice equal to your Ranger level); Beast's Strike deals 1d8 + 2 plus your Wisdom modifier damage. Sea: Hit Points 5 plus five times your Ranger level (d8 Hit Dice equal to your Ranger level); Beast's Strike deals 1d6 + 2 plus your Wisdom modifier damage and Grapples the target. Sky: Hit Points 4 plus four times your Ranger level (d6 Hit Dice equal to your Ranger level); Beast's Strike deals 1d4 + 3 plus your Wisdom modifier Slashing damage. The beast moves and uses its Reaction on its own, but only takes the Dodge action unless you take a Bonus Action to command it, or sacrifice one of your attacks to command Beast's Strike.

7.name: Exceptional Training
7.description: On any of your turns when your beast companion doesn't attack, you can use a bonus action to command the beast to take the Dash, Disengage, or Help action on its turn. In addition, the beast's attacks now count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

11.name: Bestial Fury
11.description: When you command your beast companion to take the Attack action, the beast can make two attacks, or it can take the Multiattack action if it has that action.

15.name: Share Spells
15.description: When you cast a spell targeting yourself, you can also affect your beast companion with the spell if the beast is within 30 feet of you.

subclasses.name: Gloom Stalker
subclasses.description: Master of the Underdark and deep shadows

3.name: Dread Ambusher
3.description: At the start of your first turn of each combat, your Speed increases by 10 feet until the end of that turn. When you attack a creature and hit it with a weapon, you can deal an extra 2d6 Psychic damage; you can use this benefit only once per turn, a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), regaining all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. At 11th level the damage becomes 2d8 (see Stalker's Flurry).

3.name: Gloom Stalker Spells
3.description: You always have these spells prepared — Disguise Self at 3rd, Rope Trick at 5th, Fear at 9th, Greater Invisibility at 13th, Seeming at 17th.

3.name: Umbral Sight
3.description: You gain Darkvision out to a range of 60 feet; if you already have Darkvision, its range increases by 60 feet. While entirely in Darkness, you have the Invisible condition against any creature that relies on Darkvision to see you in that Darkness.

7.name: Iron Mind
7.description: You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws. If you already have this proficiency, you instead gain proficiency in Intelligence or Charisma saving throws (your choice).

11.name: Stalker's Flurry
11.description: The Psychic damage of your Dreadful Strike becomes 2d8. In addition, when you use Dreadful Strike, you can cause one additional effect: Sudden Strike — make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature within 5 feet of the original target and within the weapon's range; or Mass Fear — the target and each creature within 10 feet of it must make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or be Frightened.

15.name: Shadowy Dodge
15.description: When a creature makes an attack roll against you, you can use your Reaction to impose Disadvantage on that roll. Whether the attack hits or misses, after it is resolved you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

subclasses.name: Horizon Walker
subclasses.description: Guardian against threats from other planes

3.name: Detect Portal
3.description: As an action, you detect the distance and direction to the closest planar portal within 1 mile of you. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

3.name: Planar Warrior
3.description: As a bonus action, choose one creature you can see within 30 feet. The next time you hit that creature on this turn with a weapon attack, all damage dealt by the attack becomes force damage, and the creature takes an extra 1d8 force damage (2d8 at 11th level).

7.name: Ethereal Step
7.description: You can cast Etherealness with this feature, without expending a spell slot, but the spell ends at the end of the current turn. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

11.name: Distant Strike
11.description: You gain the ability to pass between the planes in the blink of an eye. When you take the Attack action, you can teleport up to 10 feet before each attack to an unoccupied space you can see. If you attack at least two different creatures with the action, you can make one additional attack against a third creature.

15.name: Spectral Defense
15.description: When you take damage from an attack, you can use your reaction to give yourself resistance to all of that attack's damage on this turn.

subclasses.name: Monster Slayer
subclasses.description: Expert at hunting down dangerous creatures

3.name: Hunter's Sense
3.description: As an action, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet. You immediately learn whether the creature has any damage immunities, resistances, or vulnerabilities and what they are. If the creature is hidden from divination magic, you sense that it has no damage immunities, resistances, or vulnerabilities. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier.

3.name: Slayer's Prey
3.description: As a bonus action, you designate one creature you can see within 60 feet as your prey. The first time each turn that you hit that target with a weapon attack, it takes an extra 1d6 damage.

7.name: Supernatural Defense
7.description: Whenever the target of your Slayer's Prey forces you to make a saving throw and whenever you make an ability check to escape that target's grapple, add 1d6 to your roll.

11.name: Magic-User's Nemesis
11.description: When you see a creature casting a spell or teleporting within 60 feet, you can use your reaction to try to magically foil it. The creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC, or its spell or teleport fails.

15.name: Slayer's Counter
15.description: If the target of your Slayer's Prey forces you to make a saving throw, you can use your reaction to make one weapon attack against the quarry. You make this attack immediately before making the saving throw. If your attack hits, your save automatically succeeds.

subclasses.name: Fey Wanderer
subclasses.description: Mystical wanderer touched by the Feywild

3.name: Dreadful Strikes
3.description: You can augment your weapon strikes with mind-scarring magic. Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a weapon, you can deal an extra 1d4 psychic damage (1d6 at 11th level).

3.name: Fey Wanderer Spells
3.description: You always have these spells prepared — Charm Person at 3rd, Misty Step at 5th, Summon Fey at 9th, Dimension Door at 13th, Mislead at 17th.

3.name: Otherworldly Glamour
3.description: Your fey qualities give you a supernatural charm. You gain proficiency in one of the following skills: Deception, Performance, or Persuasion. You can also add your Wisdom modifier to any Charisma check you make.

7.name: Beguiling Twist
7.description: The magic of the Feywild guards your mind. You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened. In addition, whenever you or a creature you can see within 120 feet succeeds on a saving throw against being charmed or frightened, you can use your reaction to force a different creature you can see within 120 feet to make a Wisdom save or become charmed or frightened by you for 1 minute.

11.name: Fey Reinforcements
11.description: You can cast Summon Fey without a material component. You can also cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. Whenever you start casting the spell, you can modify it so that it doesn't require concentration. If you do so, the spell's duration becomes 1 minute.

15.name: Misty Wanderer
15.description: You can cast Misty Step without expending a spell slot. You can do so a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest. In addition, when you cast Misty Step, you can bring along one willing creature within 5 feet of you.

subclasses.name: Swarmkeeper
subclasses.description: Ranger accompanied by a swarm of nature spirits

3.name: Gathered Swarm
3.description: A swarm of intangible nature spirits has bonded itself to you. Once per turn, you can cause the swarm to assist you in one of the following ways immediately after you hit a creature with an attack: deal 1d6 piercing damage to the target, the target must succeed on a Strength save or be moved 15 feet horizontally, or you are moved 5 feet horizontally by the swarm. The damage increases to 1d8 at 11th level.

7.name: Writhing Tide
7.description: You can condense part of your swarm into a focused mass that lifts you up. As a bonus action, you gain a flying speed of 10 feet and can hover for 1 minute. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus.

11.name: Mighty Swarm
11.description: Your Gathered Swarm grows mightier: the damage of Gathered Swarm increases to 1d8. If a creature fails its saving throw against being moved by Gathered Swarm, you can also knock the creature prone. When you are moved by Gathered Swarm, it gives you half cover until the start of your next turn.

15.name: Swarming Dispersal
15.description: When you take damage, you can use your reaction to give yourself resistance to that damage. You vanish into your swarm and then teleport to an unoccupied space that you can see within 30 feet. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus.

subclasses.name: Drakewarden
subclasses.description: Bond with a draconic companion

3.name: Draconic Gift
3.description: The bond you share with your drake creates a connection to dragonkind. You learn to speak, read, and write Draconic. You learn the Thaumaturgy cantrip, which is a ranger spell for you.

3.name: Drake Companion
3.description: As an action, you can summon your drake companion. It appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within 30 feet. The drake is friendly to you and your companions, and it obeys your commands. In combat, the drake shares your initiative count, but takes its turn immediately after yours. It can move and use its reaction on its own, but the only action it takes is the Dodge action, unless you take a bonus action to command it.

7.name: Bond of Fang and Scale
7.description: The bond between you and your drake intensifies, granting you new powers: the drake can be Medium or Small (your choice), you can mount the drake if it is Medium, the drake's Infused Strikes damage increases to 1d6, and you gain resistance to the damage type of your drake's Draconic Essence (Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison).

11.name: Drake's Breath
11.description: As an action, you can exhale a 30-foot cone of damaging breath or cause your drake to exhale it. Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison damage. Each creature in the cone must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest, unless you expend a spell slot of 3rd level or higher to use it again.

15.name: Perfected Bond
15.description: Your bond to your drake reaches the pinnacle of its power. The drake can now be Large, its Infused Strikes damage increases to 2d6, and when either you or the drake takes damage while you're within 30 feet of each other, you can use your reaction to give yourself or the drake resistance to that instance of damage. You can use this reaction a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus.

subclasses.name: Stone Singer
subclasses.description: Rangers who hear the ancient songs of the earth itself, communing with stone and using its power to protect the natural world

3.name: Stone's Song
3.description: You can hear the whispers of the earth. You gain tremorsense with a range of 30 feet. Additionally, you can spend 1 minute communing with the ground to learn information about the surrounding area within 1 mile, including the location of underground passages, mineral deposits, or creatures touching the ground.

3.name: Earth Strike
3.description: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can cause stone to momentarily rise from the ground and strike your target. The creature takes an extra 1d6 bludgeoning damage and must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have its speed reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn. This damage increases to 2d6 at 11th level.

7.name: Earthen Armor
7.description: As a bonus action, you can call stone to encase your body, granting you a +2 bonus to AC. This armor lasts for 1 hour or until you dismiss it as a bonus action. While wearing this armor, you have disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks but have advantage on saving throws against being moved against your will. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus.

11.name: Reshape the Land
11.description: You can manipulate the earth around you. As an action, you can raise or lower an area of earth or stone up to 10 feet square by up to 10 feet. Creatures in the area when it changes must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier.

15.name: Heart of the Mountain
15.description: You gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. Additionally, when you use your Earthen Armor feature, the bonus to AC increases to +3, and you have advantage on all saving throws against spells and magical effects.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.description: A scoundrel who wins with stealth, trickery, and a blade in the dark. You pick the lock, spot the trap, and strike where it hurts before anyone knows you were there.
features: Expertise - Choose two skills to double your proficiency bonus for ability checks
Sneak Attack - You know how to strike subtly and exploit a foe's distraction
Thieves' Cant - You know thieves' cant, a secret mix of dialect, jargon, and code

subclasses.name: Thief
subclasses.description: Master of stealth and cunning

3.name: Fast Hands
3.description: As a Bonus Action, make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check to pick a lock, disarm a trap with Thieves' Tools, or pick a pocket — or take the Utilize action, or a Magic action to use a magic item that requires that action.

3.name: Second-Story Work
3.description: You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed, and you determine jump distance using Dexterity rather than Strength.

9.name: Supreme Sneak
9.description: You gain the Stealth Attack Cunning Strike option (Cost 1d6): if you have the Hide action's Invisible condition, this attack doesn't end that condition on you if you end the turn behind Three-Quarters Cover or Total Cover.

13.name: Use Magic Device
13.description: You can attune to up to four magic items at once. Whenever you use a magic item property that expends charges, roll 1d6; on a 6, you use the property without expending the charges. You can use any Spell Scroll, using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability; a cantrip or level 1 spell casts reliably, while a higher-level spell needs an Intelligence (Arcana) check (DC 10 + the spell's level) — success casts it, failure disintegrates the scroll.

17.name: Thief's Reflexes
17.description: You can take two turns during the first round of any combat. You take your first turn at your normal initiative and your second turn at your initiative minus 10.

subclasses.name: Assassin
subclasses.description: Expert in dealing sudden, lethal strikes

3.name: Assassin's Tools
3.description: You gain a Disguise Kit and a Poisoner's Kit, and proficiency with them.

3.name: Assassinate
3.description: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls. During the first round of combat, you have Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn yet, and if your Sneak Attack hits a target during that round, the target takes extra damage of the weapon's type equal to your Rogue level.

9.name: Infiltration Expertise
9.description: You can unerringly mimic another person's speech, handwriting, or both if you spent at least 1 hour studying them, and your Speed isn't reduced to 0 by using Steady Aim.

13.name: Envenom Weapons
13.description: When you use the Poison option of Cunning Strike, the target also takes 2d6 Poison damage whenever it fails the saving throw, and this damage ignores Resistance to Poison damage.

17.name: Death Strike
17.description: When you hit with Sneak Attack on the first round of combat, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + your Dexterity modifier + your proficiency bonus) or the attack's damage is doubled against it.

subclasses.name: Arcane Trickster
subclasses.description: Rogue who blends stealth with arcane trickery

3.name: Spellcasting
3.description: You learn to cast spells. You learn three cantrips: Mage Hand and two other cantrips of your choice from the Wizard spell list, and you learn three 1st-level Wizard spells of your choice. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells. You learn a fourth cantrip at 10th level, and the number of spells you have prepared increases as shown on the Arcane Trickster Spellcasting table.

3.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
3.description: You can cast Mage Hand as a Bonus Action. The hand is Invisible, you control it as a Bonus Action, and you can make Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks through it.

9.name: Magical Ambush
9.description: If you have the Invisible condition when you cast a spell on a creature, it has Disadvantage on any saving throw it makes against the spell on the same turn.

13.name: Versatile Trickster
13.description: When you use the Trip option of Cunning Strike on a creature, you can also use that option on another creature within 5 feet of the spectral hand.

17.name: Spell Thief
17.description: Immediately after a creature casts a spell that targets you or includes you in its area of effect, you can use your Reaction to force an Intelligence saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, you negate the spell's effect against you and steal the knowledge of it if it is at least 1st level and of a level you can cast (it needn't be a Wizard spell); you have it prepared for 8 hours, and the creature can't cast it until the 8 hours have passed. Once per Long Rest.

subclasses.name: Swashbuckler
subclasses.description: Dashing duelist who uses charm and agility

3.name: Fancy Footwork
3.description: During your turn, if you make a melee attack against a creature, that creature can't make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of your turn.

3.name: Rakish Audacity
3.description: Your confidence propels you into battle. You can give yourself a bonus to your initiative rolls equal to your Charisma modifier. You also gain an additional way to use your Sneak Attack; you don't need advantage on the attack roll to use your Sneak Attack against a creature if you are within 5 feet of it, no other creature is within 5 feet of you, and you don't have disadvantage on the attack roll. All the other rules for Sneak Attack still apply to you.

9.name: Panache
9.description: Your charm becomes extraordinarily beguiling. As an action, you can make a Charisma (Persuasion) check contested by a creature's Wisdom (Insight) check. The creature must be able to hear you, and the two of you must share a language. If you succeed and the creature is hostile to you, it has disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than you and can't make opportunity attacks against targets other than you. If you succeed and the creature isn't hostile to you, it is charmed by you for 1 minute.

13.name: Elegant Maneuver
13.description: You can use a bonus action on your turn to gain advantage on the next Dexterity (Acrobatics) or Strength (Athletics) check you make during the same turn.

17.name: Master Duelist
17.description: Your mastery of the blade lets you turn failure into success in combat. If you miss with an attack roll, you can roll it again with advantage. Once you do so, you can't use this feature again until you finish a short or long rest.

subclasses.name: Scout
subclasses.description: Skirmisher and survivalist who excels in ambushes

3.name: Skirmisher
3.description: You are difficult to pin down during a fight. You can move up to half your speed as a reaction when an enemy ends its turn within 5 feet of you. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

3.name: Survivalist
3.description: You gain proficiency in the Nature and Survival skills if you don't already have it. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of those proficiencies.

9.name: Superior Mobility
9.description: Your walking speed increases by 10 feet. If you have a climbing or swimming speed, this increase applies to that speed as well.

13.name: Ambush Master
13.description: You excel at leading ambushes and acting first in a fight. You have advantage on initiative rolls. In addition, the first creature you hit during the first round of a combat becomes easier for you and others to strike; attack rolls against that target have advantage until the start of your next turn.

17.name: Sudden Strike
17.description: You can strike with deadly speed. If you take the Attack action on your turn, you can make one additional attack as a bonus action. This attack can benefit from your Sneak Attack even if you have already used it this turn, but you can't use your Sneak Attack against the same target more than once in a turn.

subclasses.name: Phantom
subclasses.description: Rogue with a connection to the dead

3.name: Whispers of the Dead
3.description: Echoes of those who have died cling to you. Whenever you finish a short or long rest, you can gain one skill or tool proficiency of your choice, as a ghostly presence shares its knowledge with you. You lose this proficiency when you use this feature to choose a different proficiency that you lack.

3.name: Wails from the Grave
3.description: Immediately after you deal your Sneak Attack damage to a creature on your turn, you can target a second creature that you can see within 30 feet of the first creature. Roll half the number of Sneak Attack dice for your level (round up), and the second creature takes necrotic damage equal to the roll's total, as wails of the dead sound around them for a moment. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus.

9.name: Tokens of the Departed
9.description: When a life ends in your presence, you're able to snatch a token from the departing soul. When a creature you can see dies within 30 feet of you, you can use your reaction to create a soul trinket. You can have a maximum number of soul trinkets equal to your proficiency bonus, and you can't create one while at your maximum. You can use soul trinkets in the following ways: while a soul trinket is on your person, you have advantage on death saving throws and Constitution saving throws; when you deal Sneak Attack damage on your turn, you can destroy one of your soul trinkets to deal extra necrotic damage to the target equal to half your Sneak Attack damage dice, rounded up; as an action, you can destroy a soul trinket to ask the spirit associated with it one question and it answers in a language it knew in life.

13.name: Ghost Walk
13.description: You can phase partially into the realm of the dead, becoming like a ghost. As a bonus action, you assume a spectral form. While in this form, you have a flying speed of 10 feet, you can hover, and attack rolls have disadvantage against you. You can also move through creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain, but you take 1d10 force damage if you end your turn inside a creature or an object. You stay in this form for 10 minutes or until you end it as a bonus action.

17.name: Death's Friend
17.description: Your association with death has become so close that you gain the following benefits: When you use your Wails from the Grave, you can deal the necrotic damage to both the first and the second creature. At the end of a long rest, a soul trinket appears in your hand if you don't have any soul trinkets, as the spirits of the dead are drawn to you.

subclasses.name: Soulknife
subclasses.description: Rogue who manifests psychic blades

3.name: Psionic Power
3.description: You harbor a wellspring of psionic energy within yourself. This energy is represented by your Psionic Energy dice: d6 x4 at 3rd level, d8 x6 at 5th, d8 x8 at 9th, d10 x8 at 11th, d10 x10 at 13th, d12 x12 at 17th. You regain 1 on a Short Rest and all on a Long Rest. You can use them for Psi-Bolstered Knack, Psychic Whispers, and other features.

3.name: Psychic Blades
3.description: You can manifest your psionic power as shimmering blades of psychic energy. Whenever you take the Attack action or make an Opportunity Attack, you can manifest a Psychic Blade from your free hand and make the attack with that blade. This magic blade is a Simple Melee weapon dealing 1d6 Psychic damage + your ability modifier, with the Finesse and Thrown (60/120 ft) properties and Mastery: Vex. It vanishes immediately after it hits or misses its target. After you attack with the blade, you can make a melee or ranged attack with a second psychic blade as a Bonus Action on the same turn, provided your other hand is free (damage die 1d4 instead of 1d6).

3.name: Psi-Bolstered Knack
3.description: If you fail an ability check using a skill or tool with which you have proficiency, roll one Psionic Energy Die and add the number rolled to the check; the die is expended only if the roll then succeeds.

3.name: Psychic Whispers
3.description: As a Magic action, choose up to your Proficiency Bonus creatures you can see and roll one Psionic Energy Die; for a number of hours equal to the roll, the chosen creatures can speak telepathically with you (within 1 mile). The first use after each Long Rest doesn't expend the die.

9.name: Soul Blades
9.description: Your Psychic Blades are now an expression of your psi-suffused soul. You gain the following abilities: Homing Strikes (if you make an attack roll with your psychic blade and miss the target, you can roll one Psionic Energy die and add the number rolled to the attack roll) and Psychic Teleportation (as a bonus action, you manifest one of your psychic blades, expend one Psionic Energy die and roll it, and throw the blade at an unoccupied space you can see, up to a number of feet away equal to 10 times the number rolled. You then teleport to that space, and the blade vanishes).

13.name: Psychic Veil
13.description: You can weave a veil of psychic static to mask yourself. As a Magic action, you can magically become invisible, along with anything you are wearing or carrying, for 1 hour or until you dismiss this effect (no action required). This invisibility ends early immediately after you deal damage to a creature or you force a creature to make a saving throw. Once per Long Rest unless you expend a Psionic Energy Die to restore your use.

17.name: Rend Mind
17.description: You can sweep your Psychic Blades directly through a creature's mind. When you use your Psychic Blades to deal Sneak Attack damage to a creature, you can force that target to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier). If the save fails, the target is stunned for 1 minute. The stunned target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Once per Long Rest unless you expend three Psionic Energy Dice to restore your use.

subclasses.name: Magic Stealer
subclasses.description: Rogues who specialize in stealing and disrupting magical power, turning their enemies' spells against them

3.name: Arcane Larceny
3.description: You have learned the art of stealing magical energy. When a creature within 30 feet of you casts a spell, you can use your reaction to attempt to siphon some of its power. Make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check contested by the caster's spellcasting ability check. On a success, you gain a number of stolen spell points equal to the level of the spell cast (cantrips count as 0). You can store a maximum number of stolen spell points equal to your proficiency bonus.

3.name: Spell Sense
3.description: You can sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of you. You know if there are any spells or magical effects in this area, and their general direction, but not their exact nature or location.

9.name: Disruptive Strike
9.description: When you deal Sneak Attack damage to a creature that is concentrating on a spell, the creature has disadvantage on the Constitution saving throw to maintain concentration. Additionally, you can expend stolen spell points to deal extra force damage equal to 1d6 per point spent (maximum of 5d6).

13.name: Spell Redirect
13.description: When you successfully use your Arcane Larceny feature, you can choose to redirect the spell instead of stealing its energy. The spell targets a creature of your choice within its normal range, using the original caster's spell save DC and spell attack bonus. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

17.name: Master Thief of Magic
17.description: Your ability to steal magic reaches its peak. You can now store a maximum of stolen spell points equal to twice your proficiency bonus. When you use your Arcane Larceny feature, you automatically succeed on the contest if the spell is 3rd level or lower. Additionally, as an action, you can expend 5 stolen spell points to cast Counterspell or Dispel Magic without expending a spell slot.

subclasses.name: Slider
subclasses.description: Rogues known as Sliders have mastered the art of dimensional manipulation, slipping through the spaces between reality to strike from unexpected angles

3.name: Phase Step
3.description: You can slip through the fabric of reality. As a bonus action, you can teleport up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. After teleporting, you have advantage on the next attack roll you make before the end of your turn. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a short or long rest.

3.name: Dimensional Sense
3.description: You can sense disturbances in the fabric of reality. You can detect any teleportation, conjuration magic, or planar portals within 60 feet of you. You also have advantage on saving throws against being banished or teleported against your will.

9.name: Slip Strike
9.description: When you deal Sneak Attack damage to a creature, you can choose to partially phase through it. The target must make a Constitution saving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier). On a failed save, the creature is disoriented and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

13.name: Phase Walk
13.description: Your connection to dimensional spaces deepens. You can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. You take 1d10 force damage if you end your turn inside an object. Additionally, your Phase Step range increases to 30 feet.

17.name: Dimensional Ambush
17.description: You can strike from impossible angles. When you use your Phase Step feature, you can teleport up to 60 feet and can teleport to a space you cannot see, as long as you've seen it within the last minute. Additionally, attacks you make immediately after using Phase Step are critical hits on a roll of 18-20.

subclasses.name: Surgeon
subclasses.description: Rogues who combine anatomical knowledge with precise blade work, capable of healing allies and crippling foes with surgical precision

3.name: Surgical Expertise
3.description: You gain proficiency in the Medicine skill. If you already have it, you gain expertise in it instead. You can use Intelligence instead of Wisdom for Medicine checks. Additionally, you gain proficiency with the herbalism kit and poisoner's kit.

3.name: Wound Knowledge
3.description: As a bonus action, you can make a Medicine check (DC equal to target's AC) against a creature you can see within 30 feet. On success, you learn the creature's AC, approximate remaining hit points, and any damage vulnerabilities. For the next 10 minutes, you can apply your Sneak Attack damage to attacks against that creature even if you don't have advantage, as long as you don't have disadvantage.

9.name: Patch Up
9.description: As an action, you can tend to a creature within 5 feet, restoring 1d8 + your proficiency bonus hit points. You can also cure one of the following conditions: blinded, deafened, paralyzed, poisoned, stunned, or petrified. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1) per long rest.

13.name: Medical Miracle
13.description: You can attempt to revive a creature that has died within the last minute. As an action, you make a DC 15 Medicine check. On success, the creature returns to life with 1 hit point and gains temporary hit points equal to twice your proficiency bonus. The revived creature suffers one level of exhaustion. You can use this feature once per long rest.

17.name: Advanced Surgical Assessment
17.description: When you hit a creature you have studied with Wound Knowledge and deal Sneak Attack damage, you can choose to perform a crippling surgical strike instead of dealing your Sneak Attack damage. Choose one effect: Hamstring (the creature's speed is halved), Sever Artery (the creature takes 4d4 piercing damage at the start of each of its turns), Damage Larynx (the creature cannot speak or cast spells with verbal components), or Damage Eyes (the creature is blinded). The creature can make a Constitution saving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence modifier) at the end of each of its turns to end the effect. Once a creature succeeds, it is immune to your surgical strikes for 24 hours.

sorcerer.name: Sorcerer
sorcerer.description: A spellcaster whose magic is in their blood — a gift, a curse, or a bloodline they never asked for. You don't study spells; you are the spell, raw and wild, and your power answers to instinct before it answers to you.
features: Spellcasting - You can cast sorcerer spells using Charisma as your spellcasting ability
Sorcerous Origin - Choose an origin for your innate magic
Font of Magic - You can tap into your inner wellspring of magic to create spell slots

subclasses.name: Draconic Bloodline
subclasses.description: Magic flowing from a draconic ancestor

1.name: Dragon Ancestor
1.description: You choose one type of dragon as your ancestor. The damage type associated with each dragon is used by features you gain later. You can speak, read, and write Draconic. Additionally, whenever you make a Charisma check when interacting with dragons, your proficiency bonus is doubled if it applies to the check.

1.name: Draconic Resilience
1.description: As magic flows through your body, it causes physical traits of your dragon ancestors to emerge. Your hit point maximum increases by 1 and increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level in this class. Additionally, parts of your skin are covered by a thin sheen of dragon-like scales. When you aren't wearing armor, your AC equals 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

6.name: Elemental Affinity
6.description: When you cast a spell that deals damage of the type associated with your draconic ancestry, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of that spell. At the same time, you can spend 1 sorcery point to gain resistance to that damage type for 1 hour.

14.name: Dragon Wings
14.description: You gain the ability to sprout a pair of dragon wings from your back, gaining a flying speed equal to your current speed. You can create these wings as a bonus action on your turn. They last until you dismiss them as a bonus action on your turn. You can't manifest your wings while wearing armor unless the armor is made to accommodate them, and clothing not made to accommodate your wings might be destroyed when you manifest them.

18.name: Draconic Presence
18.description: You can channel the dread presence of your dragon ancestor, causing those around you to become awestruck or frightened. As an action, you can spend 5 sorcery points to draw on this power and exude an aura of awe or fear (your choice) to a distance of 60 feet. For 1 minute or until you lose your concentration (as if you were casting a concentration spell), each hostile creature that starts its turn in this aura must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed (if you chose awe) or frightened (if you chose fear) until the aura ends.

subclasses.name: Wild Magic
subclasses.description: Chaotic magic that can surge unexpectedly

1.name: Wild Magic Surge
1.description: Your spellcasting can unleash surges of untamed magic. Once per turn, the DM can have you roll a d20 immediately after you cast a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher. If you roll a 1, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table to create a magical effect. If that effect is a spell, it is too wild to be affected by your Metamagic, and if it normally requires concentration, it doesn't require concentration in this case; the spell lasts for its full duration.

1.name: Tides of Chaos
1.description: You can manipulate the forces of chance and chaos to gain advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. Once you do so, you must finish a long rest before you can use this feature again. Any time before you regain the use of this feature, the DM can have you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table immediately after you cast a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher. You then regain the use of this feature.

6.name: Bend Luck
6.description: You have the ability to twist fate using your wild magic. When another creature you can see makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can use your reaction and spend 2 sorcery points to roll 1d4 and apply the number rolled as a bonus or penalty (your choice) to the creature's roll. You can do so after the creature rolls but before any effects of the roll occur.

14.name: Controlled Chaos
14.description: You gain a modicum of control over the surges of your wild magic. Whenever you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table, you can roll twice and use either number.

18.name: Spell Bombardment
18.description: The harmful energy of your spells intensifies. When you roll damage for a spell and roll the highest number possible on any of the dice, choose one of those dice, roll it again and add that roll to the damage. You can use the feature only once per turn.

subclasses.name: Divine Soul
subclasses.description: Blessed with divine magic from a celestial source

1.name: Divine Magic
1.description: Your link to the divine allows you to learn spells from the cleric class. When your Spellcasting feature lets you learn or replace a sorcerer cantrip or a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher, you can choose the new spell from the cleric spell list or the sorcerer spell list. You must otherwise obey all the restrictions for selecting the spell, and it becomes a sorcerer spell for you.
