You learn the Druidcraft and Spare the Dying cantrips, which count as wizard cantrips for you but don't count against your number of cantrips known. Additionally, you gain proficiency in the Medicine and Nature skills if you don't already have them.

2.name: Practical Spellcasting
2.description: When you cast a wizard spell that restores hit points or removes a condition, you can add your Intelligence modifier to the amount of healing done. Additionally, the gold and time you must spend to copy a spell into your spellbook is halved if the spell is of the abjuration, divination, or transmutation school.

6.name: Community Guardian
6.description: Your protective magic extends to those around you. When you cast an abjuration spell of 1st level or higher that targets only yourself, you can have it also target one additional creature within 30 feet. At 10th level, you can target two additional creatures. At 14th level, you can target three additional creatures.

10.name: Resourceful Casting
10.description: You've learned to stretch your magical resources. When you cast a wizard spell using a spell slot, you can choose to cast it at one level lower than the slot expended (minimum 1st level). If you do, you regain a spell slot of that lower level. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

14.name: Master of the Hearth
14.description: Your protective magic reaches its peak. You can cast Warding Bond without expending a spell slot and without requiring material components. When you do so, you don't suffer the damage sharing drawback of the spell, though you still share other effects. Additionally, whenever a creature protected by your Community Guardian or Warding Bond takes damage, you can use your reaction to reduce that damage by an amount equal to your wizard level. You can use this reaction a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

subclasses.name: School of Theurgy
subclasses.description: Theurgists blend arcane and divine magic, adopting a cleric domain and channeling its power through wizardly study and arcane formulas

2.name: Arcane Initiate
2.description: Choose a cleric domain. You learn that domain's spells at the cleric levels specified and can add them to your spellbook as wizard spells. These domain spells don't count against the number of spells you can prepare. You also gain Channel Arcana with two uses per short or long rest: Divine Arcana lets you add a d4 to an attack roll or saving throw DC for a wizard spell, and you gain the domain's 2nd-level Channel Divinity option.

6.name: Arcane Acolyte
6.description: You gain your chosen domain's 1st-level cleric features, excluding any weapon or armor proficiency grants. If a domain feature references your Wisdom modifier, you can use your Intelligence modifier instead. You can use Channel Arcana three times per short or long rest.

10.name: Arcane Priest
10.description: You gain your chosen domain's 6th-level cleric feature. If the feature references your cleric level, use your wizard level instead. If it references your Wisdom modifier, you can use your Intelligence modifier instead.

14.name: Arcane High Priest
14.description: You gain your chosen domain's 17th-level capstone feature, achieving divine mastery earlier than any cleric. If the feature references your cleric level, use your wizard level. If it references your Wisdom modifier, you can use your Intelligence modifier instead. You can use Channel Arcana four times per short or long rest.

spellshot.description: A gunslinger who channels magic through firearms. You fight in the thick of danger, building power with every shot, and spend it to cast spells and fire shots no ordinary gun could make.
features: Explosive Arsenal - Proficient in firearms; your arsenal holds up to your proficiency bonus in firearms, chosen after a short or long rest
Adrenaline Dynamo - Gain Dynamo points by hitting, critically hitting, or dropping Worthy creatures with arsenal attacks, and by succeeding on Dexterity saves
Skill Shots - Learn trick shots for your firearms, 3 at 1st level rising to 7
Spell Battery - From 2nd level, cast spells by spending Dynamo points instead of spell slots
Spell Dynamo - Regain Dynamo points when your spells hit or affect Worthy creatures
Drive - At 3rd level, choose a Drive: Bullet Weaver, Thrill Seeker, Virtuoso, or Wildcard
Extra Attack - At 5th level, attack twice with the Attack action
Enchanted Arsenal - From 6th level, arsenal weapons count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity
Arcane Ammunitions - From 6th level, craft special bullets (Dragonfire, Infusing, Armor-penetrating), max 5 per long rest
Quick Swap - From 6th level, stowing and drawing arsenal weapons needs no object interaction
Unshakeable Grit - From 9th level, keep Dynamo up to your proficiency bonus after a rest instead of losing it all
Quickdraw - From 9th level, spend 3 Dynamo on initiative to add your proficiency bonus and make an advantaged arsenal attack
Improved Weapons - From 11th level, create firearms from the Improved table, max 2 in your arsenal
Elemental Arsenal - From 11th level, wreath your arsenal in an element when you spend Dynamo, adding extra damage dice to first hits
Speed Loader - From 13th level, reload a firearm as a bonus action
Improved Ammunitions - From 14th level, your special bullets gain stronger effects
Mastered Weapons - From 17th level, create firearms from the Mastered table, max 1 in your arsenal
Unrelenting Grit - From 18th level, keep up to twice your proficiency bonus on a rest, with floors after a long rest and at initiative
Determined Desperado - At 20th level, Dynamo is Unlimited, every Dynamo gain yields one extra point, and you may use any number of learned Skill Shots when you attack
spellshot.name: Spellshot

spellcasting.spellListNote: 29 spells (1st-5th) per the digest; 7 are new spells with full text in the source document. Catalog entries are another agent's job — do not duplicate the list here.

subclasses.description: Infuse spells into your bullets and store spells in ammunition for later release.

10.description: Learn 3 spells of 3rd level or lower from any class list, castable only via Delayed Spells.
10.name: Infused Secrets

10.description: Delayed Spells may target a non-arsenal weapon.
10.name: Infusion Prowess

15.description: 13 Dynamo, bonus action, 1 minute, 1/short-or-long rest: damage becomes force, concentrate on two Spell Battery spells, reload all arsenal as a bonus action or attack.
15.name: One with the Weave

3.description: As an action, infuse your next firearm attack with a spell.
3.name: Spell Infusion

7.description: Store a spell in ammunition; uses equal your Intelligence modifier per long rest.
7.name: Delayed Spells

subclasses.name: Bullet Weaver

subclasses.description: Fight in the thick of it; the more danger, the more Dynamo, the harder you hit.

10.description: Top Gear lasts until the end of your next turn.
10.name: Full Throttle

15.description: 13 Dynamo, action: Dexterity save vs 6d8 piercing in 30 feet, +3d8 slashing within 5 feet.
15.name: Hellish Burst

3.description: Extra Dynamo-gain methods while in melee.
3.name: Bravado

3.description: A melee weapon joins your arsenal free; no close-range disadvantage; forgo proficiency on an attack to add double proficiency to damage on a hit.
3.name: Daring Arsenal

7.description: Threshold states at 3, 6, 12, and 22 Dynamo: speed, damage-die floor, AC/saving-throw bonus, extra action.
7.name: Top Gear

subclasses.name: Thrill Seeker

subclasses.description: A performer whose gunplay is an act — building to a devastating finale.

10.description: Reaction when a Worthy creature drops to 0 within 30 feet: gain 4 Dynamo, Act points set to 3; uses equal Intelligence modifier per short or long rest.
10.name: Last Whisper

15.description: 13 Dynamo, action, 1/short-or-long rest: four ranged attacks at 60/180 feet, 4d4 + Dexterity piercing each, +4d4 per subsequent hit, last hit may become a crit.
15.name: Curtain Call

3.description: Proficiency with a musical instrument and a disguise kit or calligrapher's tools.
3.name: An Artiste's Mind

3.description: Firearm attacks build Act points; at 3, your next weapon attack gains Intelligence bonus, extended crit range, no auto-miss on 1s, no misfire, doubled Dynamo gain.
3.name: Death in Four Acts

7.description: Bonus action, point within 60 feet: at the start of your next turn, 4d4 force + Wisdom save or charmed; uses equal Intelligence modifier per long rest, or 4 Dynamo when exhausted.
7.name: Captivate the Public

subclasses.name: Virtuoso

subclasses.description: Embrace the misfire — chaos is a weapon when you choose the outcome.

10.description: On a misfire roll 3d20 and choose up to two results.
10.name: Get it Together!

15.description: 13 Dynamo, action: roll 3d20, cast the spells on the d20 table at lowest level, regain Dynamo per Spell Battery.
15.name: All the Nines Break Loose!

3.description: On a misfire roll 2d20 and choose the result; spend 2 Dynamo to purposely misfire a ranged firearm attack.
3.name: Caution to the Wind!

7.description: Gain 1 Dynamo on a misfire; may turn a misfire miss into a hit; uses equal Intelligence modifier per short or long rest.
